question: Which among the following nations are associated with the 1.9 km long Feni bridge?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India and Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Feni bridge also known as **Maitri Setu** is constructed between India and Bangladesh.
 
• It is a 1.9km long bridge connecting **Sabroom (in Tripura) with Ramgarh (in Bangladesh)**.
 
• It is constructed on river **feni**.
 
• **National Highways and Infrastructure Development Corporation** Ltd have constructed a bridge.
 
• The bridge symbolises the strong bilateral relations between India and Bangladesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __**About Feni River**__

__
 
• It originates in the **South Tripura district**.
 
• It flows through Sabroom town on the Indian side and Ramgarh on the Bangladesh side.
 
• It drains into the **Bay of Bengal**.

**India- Bangladesh relations**__

__
 
• The Railway link between **Haldibari (India) and Chilahati (Bangladesh)** and the train name is **Maitree Express**.
 
• **Kolkata-Dhaka-Agartala Bus Service **was launched in 2015.
 
• Joint exercises of the **Army (Exercise Sampriti) and Navy (Exercise Milan)**.
 
• **Protocol on Inland Water Transit and Trade (PIWTT)**.
